capabilities: record audio and transcribe it at the cursor via Whisper-compatible APIs
upload audio files (mp3, mp4, m4a, wav, webm, ogg) for transcription
transcribe audio files from the file context menu
post-process transcripts with an LLM to fix grammar, remove filler words, or extract action items
create notes from transcriptions using filename and content templates
extras: Works on desktop and mobile; includes manual installation instructions via GitHub releases. Automation via iOS Shortcuts, Alfred, or any tool that can open URLs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn recorded or uploaded audio into transcribed text in a note.
